0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000010_RYNE
0.description: Restoring the elements to the Empty may allow life to flourish there once more...

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000020_RYNE
1.description: But that isn't enough to return the environment to the way it was. No, we need to gradually reintroduce life, beginning with plants.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000030_RYNE
2.description: Not just any plants, though, but those that won't be a burden on a weakened land...

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
6.description: I see you've taken an interest in gardening.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000060_RYNE
9.description: It seems you caught me rambling to myself. How embarrassing...

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000070_RYNE
10.description: I've been studying botany, you see, hoping that the knowledge would help our work in the Empty.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000080_RYNE
11.description: Coffee... If I recall correctly, it thrives in warm climates, with cooler nights to promote growth.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000090_RYNE
12.description: Yes. Yes, that might be suitable.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000100_RYNE
13.description: And with a good harvest, we could set some aside for coffee biscuits!

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000120_RYNE
15.description: It seems you caught me rambling to myself. How embarrassing...

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000130_RYNE
16.description: I've been studying botany, you see, hoping that the knowledge would help our work in the Empty.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000140_RYNE
17.description: But never mind that for now. What brings you to the Crystarium? It was my understanding that the Final Days were behind us.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000150_RYNE
18.description: You wish to combat this otherworldly threat with the power of Light...?

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000170_RYNE
20.description: Though I've lost my connection to Hydaelyn, I can still manipulate Light to a degree.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000180_RYNE
21.description: If there is a chance I could save others with that power, then I have to try.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000190_BEQLUGG
22.description: 'Tis done. Zero is now with us in the flesh.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000200_BEQLUGG
23.description: The spirit vessel, I shall hold on to for operating the tower.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000210_BEQLUGG
24.description: This will help me to make sense of the controls, will it?

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000220_BEQLUGG
25.description: There's a levity in his words that wasn't there before. It heartens me to know he is well.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000230_BEQLUGG
26.description: I shall see to the preparations as per his instructions.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000250_BEQLUGG
28.description: Think nothing of it. That said, 'tis customary that my kind receive fitting payment for services rendered...

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000260_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
29.description: Not unlike we voidsent, then. In that case, you may devour some of my aether.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000270_BEQLUGG
30.description: Are you mad? I'll do no such thing! The very suggestion is absurd!

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000280_RYNE
31.description: Now, now, let's calm down. We all have our preferences, and I'm sure no offense was intended.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000290_BEQLUGG
32.description: I shall attend to the tower now. The rest, I leave to you.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000300_RYNE
33.description: Zero, was it? My name is Ryne. It's a pleasure to meet you.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000310_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
34.description: This world isn't what I expected. While Light is indeed strong here, it's not pervasive or overwhelming. Everything looks much as it does in the Source.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000320_RYNE
35.description: We have the Warrior of Darkness to thank for that.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000330_RYNE
36.description: If you're interested, I would be glad to show you around.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000340_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
37.description: Just an ordinary sky. Ordinary...and beautiful.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000350_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
38.description: To think that, after so much loss, they could reclaim this...

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000360_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
39.description: So this is the Flood of Light...

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000370_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
40.description: I don't remember much of the time when Darkness consumed the Thirteenth. Just the cold and the emptiness...

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000400_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
43.description: You're the one who stopped this?

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000410_RYNE
44.description: Oh, no no. That was the first Oracle of Light, Minfilia. She's since left us, but I inherited her power and legacy.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000430_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
46.description: Let's get started then, shall we?

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000440_RYNE
47.description: The other transmitters are set. Whenever you're ready.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000460_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
49.description: It's almost too much for one steeped in Darkness like me...

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000480_JULLUS
51.description: Whatever may have happened in the past, you're still here, Zero. Alive.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000490_JULLUS
52.description: What you couldn't do yesterday, you might still do today.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000500_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
53.description: If this power were mine to wield...

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000510_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
54.description: [CRY OF PAIN “Argh! Ahhhhhh!] Report if displayed.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000530_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
56.description: I will not succumb... Not to Darkness...nor to Light!

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000570_RYNE
60.description: Her body struggles to contain it. She needs help.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000590_RYNE
62.description: Thank goodness... How do you feel?

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000610_RYNE
64.description: Then you're very, very lucky. Whatever possessed you to do that?

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000620_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
65.description: I had to know if I could command the Light. If I could change my fate.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000630_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
66.description: Once, I would never have dared to dream it.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000640_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
67.description: But your friendship and your trust has helped me to see new possibilities. In myself and everything else.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000650_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
68.description: Perhaps that's why, when I beheld this world once damned yet saved, I saw the potential for mine to be saved as well.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000660_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
69.description: To become a world where Light and Darkness are in harmony, and life flourishes. A world where we're not consumed by insatiable hunger, but filled with hope for what we might create together.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000670_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
70.description: If I had the strength, perhaps I could make such a dream reality. Perhaps I could awaken us from this endless nightmare.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000690_RYNE
72.description: If that's your heartfelt desire, then you mustn't be afraid to share it.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000700_RYNE
73.description: There was a time when I lacked the courage. To voice my desires was to burden those I love...or so I convinced myself.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000710_RYNE
74.description: But then I met those who believed in me. They helped me to believe in myself and find the strength to live.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000720_RYNE
75.description: And so long as I'm alive, I know that I'll be fine. No matter how dire things seem. No matter where I am.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000730_RYNE
76.description: To be able to think that brought me peace, and it's a blessing I owe entirely to my friends.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000750_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
78.description: I will remember your words. I know all too well that there's a limit to what we can achieve alone.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000760_RYNE
79.description: As a friend, I'd like to help you fulfill your dream.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000770_RYNE
80.description: If you wish to take in more Light, I can keep the power in check and help your body accept it.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
82.description: If anyone can do it, it'd be Ryne.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
83.description: It worked well enough for me.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
84.description: With the power of Light <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> Dark, you'll be unstoppable!

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000790_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
86.description: Ah, yes. You mentioned having to absorb Light. That you still live is proof of her ability.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000810_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
88.description: Right, then. I'm counting on you.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000830_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
90.description: [STRUGGLING TO ABSORB LIGHT EXERT] Report if displayed.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000840_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
91.description: I can feel it. The Light's warmth welling within me.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000860_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
93.description: With this power, I will return to the void and fight─for the world that once was, and for those I hold dear!

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000870_YSHTOLA
94.description: All is in readiness. Without further ado, then... Light from beyond the rift, shine forth and banish the Darkness!

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000880_BEQLUGG
95.description: Excellent. The tower is replete with Light from Nabaath Areng.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000900_BEQLUGG
97.description: It works! It works! Light is flowing into the void!

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000910_LYNA
98.description: May this Light illuminate your way!

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000920_RYNE
99.description: You can do it, Zero. I believe in you.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000940_YSHTOLA
101.description: It worked. Let us waste no time and sally forth.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000950_YSHTOLA
102.description: Alas, I fear the breach may be too narrow for you, Vrtra.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000960_VRITRA
103.description: For a blessing, I prepared my simulacrum for such an eventuality.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000970_VARSHAHNBIG
104.description: My true form shall stand guard here while we explore the chasm.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000980_VARSHAHNBIG
105.description: 'Tis faint, but I sense the presence of a dragon. No doubt my sister's essence trapped within Zeromus.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_000990_VARSHAHNBIG
106.description: Not where she was held captive before, but somewhere much deeper.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001000_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
107.description: The descent will not be so easy this time.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001020_YSHTOLA
109.description: Summoned by Golbez, perhaps, or born of the residual Darkness.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001030_ESTINIEN
110.description: However they came to be, we shall cut a path through them. Is everyone ready?

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001050_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
112.description: That Light should shine in the void once more...

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001060_YSHTOLA
113.description: No single one of us could have made it so. Only by joining hands were we able to kindle this Light.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001070_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
114.description: Do you see, Golbez? We needn't damn others to save ourselves.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001080_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
115.description: You knew this once, surely. When you tried to befriend me. When you were one of the precious few left willing to trust in another.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001090_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
116.description: But that man is gone, and in his place a mockery of his beliefs.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001100_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
118.description: It's the same as before... Though we walk different paths, we seek the same destination. And yet...

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001110_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
119.description: There is something I must know. A truth that lies waiting in the dark.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001130_DURANTE
121.description: This can't be happening... Not to you...

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001140_DURANTE
122.description: My friend... My hero... I will stop you even should it cost me my life!

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001150_DURANTE
123.description: [PANTING, DOWN ON ONE KNEE] Report if displayed.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001160_DURANTE
124.description: Why? Why you and not me?

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001170_DURANTE
125.description: You were the best of us. A paragon of virtue. I could never hope to be your equal.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001180_DURANTE
126.description: I am only the knight I am because of you...

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001230_DURANTE
131.description: You would not wish to become a monster, preying upon those who've fought to protect. But neither can I bring myself to kill you.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001240_DURANTE
132.description: So rest easy, my friend, and entrust your legacy to me.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001250_DURANTE
133.description: You will never die, this I swear.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001260_DURANTE
134.description: Through me your name shall live on, as the hero who saves the world!

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001270_YSHTOLA
135.description: We've been released from the memory, 'twould seem.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001280_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
136.description: If Golbez was the one sealed in this memoria...

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001290_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
137.description: Then the one we've been fighting is...

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001300_BLACKKNIGHT
138.description: No more than an impostor playing at hero.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001320_BLACKKNIGHT
140.description: A name long since lost to time. History shall remember only Golbez.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001330_BLACKKNIGHT
141.description: Come what may, I shall deliver the world its salvation, and I will not suffer you to interfere.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001340_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
142.description: You seek to free all souls from the purgatory of undeath. And to that end, you would invade another world.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001350_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
143.description: While I cannot condone your methods, I understand your motive full well.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001360_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
144.description: For I'm driven by the same. I too wish to save our world.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001370_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
145.description: I too once thought I had to bear the burden by myself. That I had no choice but to walk my path alone. But I was wrong. We may yet strive together towards our shared goal, if you would reconsider your course.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001390_BLACKKNIGHT
147.description: If you possessed power which transcended that of Zeromus, then perhaps I would.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001400_BLACKKNIGHT
148.description: But you do not. No, you are but another voidsent, like me. And what is a candle before the sun?

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001410_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
149.description: Perhaps we aren't all-powerful and cannot effect great change in an instant. Even so...

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001420_BLACKKNIGHT
150.description: Great change is what we need! Aught less has no meaning!

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001430_BLACKKNIGHT
151.description: Having glimpsed our past, you should understand as well as any.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001440_BLACKKNIGHT
152.description: As Golbez, I dedicated myself to ending the Contramemoria. I fought the corrupted memoriates, and attempted to redeem those twisted by their power.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001450_BLACKKNIGHT
153.description: Yet try as I might, I was powerless to make any meaningful change. 'Twas then, when I was floundering in despair, that she appeared─the Ascian Igeyorhm.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001460_BLACKKNIGHT
154.description: Claiming to know how to excise the source of our woes, she showed me to the moon, where the servant of Light abided. 'Twas he and his ilk who had granted men unnatural powers, she said, and now prolonged the war.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001470_BLACKKNIGHT
155.description: Believing her every word, I struck him down...and caused Darkness to engulf the world.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001480_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
156.description: What!? Then it was you who...

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001490_YSHTOLA
157.description: As Emet-Selch once told us, the Thirteenth was the Ascians' first attempt at a Rejoining, before they fully understood the mechanisms at play.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001500_YSHTOLA
158.description: They failed because they sought only to awaken the sundered Zodiark without instigating a calamity in the Source. The Darkness they unleashed had nowhere else to go...

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001510_BLACKKNIGHT
159.description: Having left a ruin of our world, the Ascian fled. I was a fool to trust them. To trust in others.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001520_BLACKKNIGHT
160.description: Since that day, I have sought the means to undo my mistake. The world may be beyond saving, but I would at least restore the great flow.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001530_BLACKKNIGHT
161.description: The dragon was an extraordinary windfall. A veritable font of aether that expedited my endeavors time and again.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001540_BLACKKNIGHT
162.description: But it wasn't enough to achieve my objective. Far from it.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001550_BLACKKNIGHT
163.description: For an eternity, I had to bide my time. But the day finally came when I acquired the power I sought.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001560_BLACKKNIGHT
164.description: Aye, the remnants of the Ascians' god sealed within the moon suddenly dispersed into aether.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001570_BLACKKNIGHT
165.description: With that aether, Zeromus could be conceived. And driven by the dragon's longing for home, it shall soon arise to destroy the barrier between worlds.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001580_BLACKKNIGHT
166.description: Thus will the way open to the promised land, and the death we have been too long denied.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001590_BLACKKNIGHT
167.description: Thus will I, Golbez, bring salvation to all!

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001600_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
168.description: So that is all you have left...

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001610_BLACKKNIGHT
169.description: Say what you will. You cannot stop Zeromus's awakening.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001620_ESTINIEN
170.description: We're going after him, aren't we?

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001630_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
171.description: Aye. That's why we came, after all. And besides...

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001640_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
172.description: When someone believes in you, it makes you want to believe in them. In others and yourself. Jullus was right about that.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001650_BLACKKNIGHT
173.description: I had hoped to bear witness to the moment our salvation is realized...

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001660_BLACKKNIGHT
174.description: But nothing must be left to chance. I will stop you here no matter the cost!

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001710_BLACKKNIGHT
179.description: Wounded as I am, I knew that I would be hard-pressed to fight you on equal terms.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001720_BLACKKNIGHT
180.description: And so I lured you to this place, where the advantage is mine!

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001740_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
182.description: Impossible. Scarmiglione and Barbariccia were sealed in memoria, while Cagnazzo and Rubicante died in the Source...

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001750_YSHTOLA
183.description: You are not wrong. They are not the true archfiends, but shades born of their residual aether.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001760_VARSHAHNBIG
184.description: If they are shades, then their strength will pale in comparison. Even should they fight as one, we may yet prevail.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001770_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
185.description: We'll tend to the archfiends. Go and put an end to Zeromus.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001790_VARSHAHNBIG
187.description: Go! We'll join you as soon as we can!

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001820_BLACKKNIGHT
190.description: It is too late. Zeromus <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> awaken, and it shall devour any who come between it and its desire. Your companion is no exception.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001840_YSHTOLA
192.description: Time and again, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> has faced insurmountable odds.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001850_ESTINIEN
193.description: But no matter how hopeless things seemed, <hex:020810E905FF067368652773FF056865277303> never given up the fight.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001860_VARSHAHNBIG
194.description: [KNOCKING BACK ENEMY EXERT] Report if displayed.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001870_VARSHAHNBIG
195.description: So long as he has strength of will to forge on, then so too shall we!

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001880_VARSHAHNBIG
196.description: So long as she has strength of will to forge on, then so too shall we!

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001890_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
197.description: For we believe in <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>, and <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> believes in us.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001900_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
198.description: And together, our Light can pierce blackest Darkness!

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001930_ZEROMUS
201.description: What is this Darkness, cold and all-consuming? Where am I?

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001940_ZEROMUS
202.description: I must return to my world... To my home, where my kin await...

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001950_ZEROMUS
203.description: Yes, I must return. I return. And none shall stand in my way!

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
206.description: I can't let you destroy the barrier between worlds!

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_001990_ZEROMUS
210.description: I shall not perish... So long as they await my return, I shall endure...

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002040_BLACKKNIGHT
215.description: Like all voidsent, Zeromus cannot be killed. Sealing it in memoria is the only way.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002070_BLACKKNIGHT
218.description: Ah, that it should come to this...

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002080_BLACKKNIGHT
219.description: I failed my dear friend. Fell for the Ascians' ploy and unleashed the Darkness.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002090_BLACKKNIGHT
220.description: And after an eternity of waiting, I find myself on my knees...

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002100_BLACKKNIGHT
221.description: How disappointed must you be in me. In the foolishness and futility of it all...

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002120_BLACKKNIGHT
223.description: No... I will not let it be for naught. I will not allow you to pass. I will triumph in my crusade!

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002130_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
224.description: There is no triumph to be found in this madness.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002140_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
225.description: Even if the veil were to be unraveled, it would not undo what Darkness has done to the world.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002150_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
226.description: Nor would it bring Golbez back. From his slumber, you know there is no return.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002160_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
227.description: You're weak and imperfect. You know it in your heart. In spite of this, do you truly believe that you can save everyone? Are you sure you will not fail?

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002170_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
228.description: I'm no better. Weak and imperfect and plagued by doubt. Which is why I need friends to walk beside me.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002190_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
230.description: This is proof that I believe in others, and they in turn believe in me.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002200_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
231.description: A light that illuminates the way in darkest despair.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002210_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
232.description: Be it in a ruined city locked in ice or a world drowning in Light, it was with faith in one another that life endured. I see it clearly now.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002220_BLACKKNIGHT
233.description: You think we are capable of the same?

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002230_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
234.description: It won't be easy. Having lived too long as voidsent, we've forgotten how to trust.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002240_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
235.description: But one thing is certain: if Zeromus succeeds and everyone dies, we'll never have the chance to try.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002250_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
236.description: You asked me to join hands with you once, and I refused. I cannot take back that mistake, but I can extend to you the same offer. We can be better than we have been.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002260_BLACKKNIGHT
237.description: [SHOCKED GASP, REMEMBERING SOMETHING] Report if displayed.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002270_BLACKKNIGHT
238.description: Of course. You were the memoriate we met all those years ago...

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002290_BLACKKNIGHT
240.description: Yes, I remember now. We hoped you would join us in our quest to end the Contramemoria.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002310_BLACKKNIGHT
242.description: It left both of us discouraged─Golbez most of all. “If we could but overcome the fear that has shaped and divided us, we could change everything.”

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002320_BLACKKNIGHT
243.description: Even in the midst of that terrible war, he never stopped believing in others. Not even at the end...

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002330_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
244.description: You're Golbez now. If you would live up to his name, then you must trust in people as he did.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002340_VARSHAHNBIG
245.description: I cannot forgive what you have done to my sister. But she may yet be saved.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002350_VARSHAHNBIG
246.description: If you can help us see her safely home and protect the Source, then...

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002360_YSHTOLA
247.description: As Zero's friends, we should gladly share what knowledge we have to help you restore the void.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002370_BLACKKNIGHT
248.description: You truly believe the world of old can be ours again?

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002380_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
249.description: I do. So long as we work together.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002390_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
250.description: We will disperse Zeromus's essence once more. The instant we do, you must call to Azdaja.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002420_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
253.description: [GASP, TAKEN BY SURPRISE] Report if displayed.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002440_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
255.description: The suffocating Darkness... Like that of the rift...

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002450_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
256.description: Impenetrable... Disorienting... Untethered and drifting further away...

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002460_ESTINIEN
257.description: Be strong, Zero! Don't give up!

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002470_VARSHAHNBIG
258.description: Hold fast to yourself! Look to the Light within!

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002480_YSHTOLA
259.description: Your place isn't alone in the Dark, Zero. Not anymore!

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002530_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
267.description: With this power from beyond the rift, I can do it. I can save everyone!

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002540_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
268.description: Golbez! If you would make amends, then lend me your strength!

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002600_VARSHAHNBIG
274.description: Hear my voice...and return to me!

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002620_AZDAJA
276.description: (-Azdaja-)I am coming, Brother... I am coming...

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002630_YSHTOLA
277.description: Have care! Zeromus makes to resurrect!

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002640_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
278.description: Not if I have anything to say about it!

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002660_VARSHAHNBIG
280.description: You're safe now, Azdaja. You're safe.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002670_VARSHAHNBIG
281.description: To my sister, I shall offer up the eye in this vessel.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002680_VARSHAHNBIG
282.description: We dragons bring forth progeny with our very life force. That which my eye harbors should be enough to grant her corporeal form.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002690_VARSHAHNBIG
283.description: Of course, this means I shall no longer have control over this vessel. I must ask you escort Azdaja to the surface in my stead.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002700_ESTINIEN
285.description: We came to bring her home, and we'll do just that. You have my word.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002720_VARSHAHNBIG
287.description: At long last, we shall be together again.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002740_BLACKKNIGHT
289.description: Our world may yet be restored. I thought it an impossible dream once, but having witnessed your miracles, I cannot help but believe.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002750_BLACKKNIGHT
290.description: Nevertheless, I am the villain who wrought this tragedy. And in my misguided crusade, I compounded my sins.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002760_BLACKKNIGHT
291.description: My place is not at your side.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002780_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
293.description: Regardless of how you may feel, by lending me your strength, you've made amends.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002795_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
295.description: It's up to you what we become to one another.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002800_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
296.description: What we couldn't do yesterday, we might still do today. Working together.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002810_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
297.description: And should we want for strength, we need only rally more like-minded souls to our cause.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002820_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
298.description: So let's take the first step. The two of us.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002830_VRITRA
299.description: Words cannot well express my relief that we could rescue my sister, nor my gratitude to all of you.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002850_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
301.description: He felt it would be inappropriate for him to be present at your reunion with Azdaja, and chose to remain down in the chasm.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002860_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
302.description: If you wish to hear an apology, however, I should be glad to drag him here.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002870_VRITRA
303.description: Nay, that shall not be necessary. By his deeds hath he demonstrated his contrition.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002880_ESTINIEN
304.description: So, what will you do now?

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002890_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
305.description: I've learned much journeying together with you. Experienced things I could never have experienced alone.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002900_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
306.description: Together with Golbez, I hope to do the same as we labor to restore the Thirteenth.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002910_ESTINIEN
307.description: Then I suppose it's farewell for now.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002920_YSHTOLA
308.description: Be sure to share with Golbez what you've learned of the Source and its reflections, as well as the true nature of Light and Dark.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002930_YSHTOLA
309.description: He is as resourceful as he is determined, and will surely make the very most of the insights.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002940_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
310.description: Indeed. Once we've gained a better understanding of the situation, I hope we can rely on your counsel.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002950_YSHTOLA
311.description: But of course. I too shall continue probing new possibilities, the better to be of aid when the time comes.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002970_YSHTOLA
313.description: From ocean rise and cloudbank form,<hex:02100103>From mountain spring and rainfall storm,<hex:02100103>From river flow and life be born...

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_002990_YSHTOLA
315.description: I revised the incantation. Which is not to say you know how it went before...

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003000_YSHTOLA
317.description: Nidhana provided me with spare warding scales, which apparently provide greater protection than before.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003010_YSHTOLA
318.description: This should keep the familiar safe. So long as you give the nixie aether from time to time, it will persist and serve as a beacon for us to find you.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003020_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
319.description: Already we find ourselves with a new ally. Thank you.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003030_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
320.description: When you have the chance, please thank everyone for me.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003070_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
324.description: A gift for Ryne, in return for the Light she helped me harness. It's the memoria holding Zeromus.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003080_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
325.description: If used to augment Darkness in the First, it may help to create balance between our worlds.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003100_YSHTOLA
327.description: Similarly, why not entrust the archfiends' memoria to Zero?

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003110_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
328.description: In that case, I shall pass them on to Golbez. To inspire and admonish him in equal measure.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
331.description: The Thirteenth is in good hands.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_A5_000_003_NONE_VOICE
332.description: You should know about Unukalhai and Cylva...

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003120_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
333.description: You will, I'm sure. Just don't try to forcibly summon me. I won't come.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003130_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
334.description: Come what may, we will see it restored. And should we need a helping hand, I hope we can count on you once more.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003140_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
335.description: What? There are others from our world who seek to restore it?

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003150_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
336.description: Then please tell them this: though we are worlds apart, in our shared objective, we walk as one.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003160_VRITRA
337.description: Sad though it is to say farewell, 'tis past time we returned home. Pray climb upon my back.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003180_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
339.description: No matter where we are or how much time passes, our bond will endure. This I believe.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003190_JULLUS
340.description: Oh, it's you again. Is everything all right?

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003200_ALPHINAUD
341.description: So you were able to rescue Azdaja... Thank the Twelve.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003210_ALISAIE
342.description: Channeling Light from the First was rather ingenious. It may fall short of cross-rift travel, but it's still an impressive achievement in my book.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003220_YSHTOLA
343.description: You're too kind. Suffice it to say, though, that I don't intend to rest on these laurels. There's always more to be done.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003230_JULLUS
344.description: Zero stayed in the void, did she? Well...if I had known it would come to that, I would've said a proper farewell.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
346.description: Zero took your words to heart.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003240_JULLUS
348.description: Really...? I don't remember saying anything profound...

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003250_JULLUS
349.description: Thanks for what? I don't recall doing anything in particular for her. On the contrary, she's the one who risked life and limb.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003260_JULLUS
350.description: Still...I'm glad that she got something out of her time here.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003270_JULLUS
351.description: As the days roll on, things will change for the both of us.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003280_JULLUS
352.description: But some things will remain as they are.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003290_JULLUS
353.description: As far as I'm concerned, Zero will always be a friend and comrade. And I will never forget her.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003300_ALISAIE
354.description: If she's working tirelessly to restore the Thirteenth, it wouldn't do to be outdone here. When next Zero visits, we must see to it that you have a shiny new Garlemald to show her.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003310_JULLUS
355.description: Indeed... And speaking of rebuilding, there's a matter I'd like to discuss with you and Alphinaud.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003320_JULLUS
356.description: Word has spread of our dealings with Radz-at-Han, and people are excited by the prospect of standing on our own two feet again. Naturally, it won't be straightforward─it never is─but on the whole, I have a good feeling about things.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003330_ALPHINAUD
357.description: In other words...it may be time for us to limit our involvement, that Garleans might take the lead? I can see the sense in that.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003340_JULLUS
358.description: No, no, that's not what I meant at all.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003350_JULLUS
359.description: Seeing as things are going well, we want you to take a rest. A <hex:021A020203>proper<hex:021A020103> rest. That's what I wanted to say, on everyone's behalf.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003360_JULLUS
360.description: You've done so much for us already. Toiled beside us in the cold for far longer than anyone could ask.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003370_JULLUS
361.description: You've earned a reprieve a hundred times over. So go on, step away from here and head...wherever you like. But if it were me, I'd choose somewhere warm.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003380_ALISAIE
362.description: I was thinking of taking a break anyway...

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003390_ALPHINAUD
363.description: Far be it from us to go against such a heartfelt request. Though I would be lying were I to say matters here wouldn't weigh on our minds...

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003400_ALISAIE
364.description: We could take a leaf out of Zero's book and roam about for a while.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003410_ALISAIE
365.description: Maybe visit nations who share little history with Garlemald─look for opportunities to foster future relations. We might learn something of recent foreign affairs that has escaped our notice.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003420_ALPHINAUD
366.description: Hm, as an independent party, we would be well suited to the task... An excellent idea, Alisaie.

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003430_JULLUS
367.description: Well, that hardly sounds like a rest at all.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003440_ALPHINAUD
368.description: To us, it is the best kind of rest─stimulating and meaningful.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003450_ALISAIE
369.description: If it's settled, then let's return to Sharlayan and consider our options.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003460_ALISAIE
370.description: What about the rest of you? Do you have any plans?

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003470_YSHTOLA
371.description: We're indebted to Lord Fourchenault and his colleagues for their cooperation. 'Twould be meet to report on the outcome of our mission.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003480_ALPHINAUD
372.description: Then it seems we are all bound for Sharlayan. Upon arriving, let us seek out Atheleys at the Rostra and have her notify Father.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003490_BEQLUGG
373.description: Ah yes, the king has already shared what they glimpsed in the Source. The day is won, and the danger passed.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003500_BEQLUGG
374.description: Hearing the tidings lifted a great weight from my shoulders. Never before had I taken on such a monumental request.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003510_LYNA
375.description: Small though it was, we are glad to have played a role in saving the Exarch's home, and yours.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003520_LYNA
376.description: Furthermore, the endeavor served to reaffirm the bond between the peoples of Norvrandt.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003530_LYNA
377.description: Nurturing this bond, we will strive to be an example for the world Zero aspires to restore.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003540_RYNE
378.description: Is that...a memoria crystal? I can feel it... The tremendous Darkness within...

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003550_RYNE
379.description: Using Darkness from the void to restore balance to this world... If such a thing could be done...!

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003560_BEQLUGG
380.description: Well, well... Though night has returned to our world, Darkness cannot arise of its own accord, much less in abundance.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003570_BEQLUGG
381.description: But if it could be brought here in like manner to how we channeled Light to the void, it may well be possible to restore the Empty in its entirety!

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003580_BEQLUGG
382.description: Do you still have that spirit vessel with you?

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003590_BEQLUGG
383.description: If so, I beg you loan it to me for a time. I would use it to investigate a way to have the tower receive rather than send energy.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003600_BEQLUGG
384.description: Thank you. I shall commence my work at once in concert with Unukalhai, and rigorously explore the possibility.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003610_BEQLUGG
385.description: Thank you. While I make no promises at this stage, I shall rigorously explore the possibility.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003620_RYNE
386.description: I too need to explore new possibilities for my powers. My recent experience at Nabaath Areng has taught me that.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003630_RYNE
387.description: To that end, I will set aside botany for a time, and focus instead on myself.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003640_RYNE
388.description: Knowing Zero is out there, doing her utmost to restore her own world... It inspires me to redouble my efforts!

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003660_GAIA
390.description: I waited and waited, but you never came. What have you been doing here?

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
395.description: Don't tell me you've lost your memory again!?

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
396.description: We promised to go for coffee biscuits, remember?

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003700_GAIA
397.description: Oh, I'm just teasing. I wouldn't forget you in a hurry.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003710_GAIA
398.description: I'm still keeping my diary, adding new memories to it every day.

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003720_RYNE
399.description: Not only that, Gaia's writing a story too. I can't wait for it to become a book!

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003730_GAIA
401.description: I never agreed to anything of the sort.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003740_GAIA
402.description: Besides, coffee biscuits are old news. I'd rather try something else.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003750_RYNE
403.description: What? I thought you liked them too... Well, no matter. The Second Serving has something for every taste, so let's just go!

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003760_GAIA
404.description: Enough about that. What were you talking about?

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003770_GAIA
405.description: Harnessing Darkness from the void... Now there's an idea.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003780_GAIA
406.description: Of course, if you're dealing with Darkness, Ryne alone won't cut it.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003790_GAIA
407.description: Next time, call on me as well. All right?

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003810_NAHBDEEN
409.description: Oh, Varshahn, my darling little brother... To think that I will never see you again...

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003820_NIDHANA
410.description: The way you carry on, anyone would think he was actually your brother...

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003830_NIDHANA
411.description: Save your tears, now. His Excellency still has one of his eyes.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003840_NIDHANA
412.description: And he has made it clear he intends to continue using his vessel. You'll see Varshahn again, never fear!

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003850_NAHBDEEN
413.description: Truly? But...will it be the little one?

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003860_NIDHANA
414.description: Personally, I prefer the adult vessel. It cuts a gallant figure, and has superior functionality besides.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003870_NAHBDEEN
415.description: Bah, I don't care about such things!

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003900_YSHTOLA
419.description: 'Tis a fine thing being so loved.

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003910_ESTINIEN
420.description: Had enough of the revelry, have you?

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003920_ESTINIEN
421.description: So, what's next for our hero?

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003930_ESTINIEN
422.description: No need to decide just yet. You'll recall our escapades in the void began with a treasure map I paid entirely too much gil for.

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003940_ESTINIEN
423.description: You can't force an adventure. It'll happen when it happens, and you'll know when the time is right.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003950_ESTINIEN
424.description: Till then, it's good to lend an ear to others and their tales. And speaking of others...

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003960_YSHTOLA
425.description: Discussing each other's plans, are we?

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003970_YSHTOLA
426.description: Alas, I have nothing exciting to share. I foresee an extended confinement in my Sharlayan chambers, compiling my theories on cross-rift travel.

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003980_YSHTOLA
427.description: My research may be classified, prohibited by the powers that be...

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_003990_YSHTOLA
428.description: But so long as a bond exists between people, ever shall our worlds be connected. As it stands, a means to travel to the First is within reach, and I would be satisfied even should my research not exist in an official capacity.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004000_YSHTOLA
429.description: And what of you, Estinien? Have you any plans?

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004020_YSHTOLA
431.description: He never was one to stay put for long. Though I've no doubt he will make himself known when needed.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004040_KRILE
433.description: Everything appears to be in order...

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004060_KRILE
436.description: So time-consuming... How nice would it be to have a mammet to handle such tasks.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004070_KRILE
437.description: Now then, let's have a look at you.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004080_KRILE
438.description: Quite old, this letter. We'll need to store it carefully.

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004090_KRILE
440.description: Addressed to Grandfather! And come all the way from Tuliyollal, from a Guloo...someone.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004100_KRILE
441.description: The ink's too faded. Hardly anything is legible.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004120_KRILE
443.description: A commission to investigate the golden city...in Tural!?

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004130_KRILE
444.description: How odd... No one ever mentioned such a commission, nor have I seen any records.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004150_KRILE
446.description: What an unusual earring. How does it relate to the petition, I wonder...

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004160_KRILE
447.description: Did you go there, Grandfather? To the golden city, in Tural?

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06500_004180_ERENVILLE
